summary: Robo.ai Inc. (formerly NWTN) furnished a Form 6-K with its interim report for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and a press release on first-half financial results. The filing is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer, incorporated by reference into its Form F-3 registration statement. No special-situation transaction (e.g., acquisition, tender offer, restructuring) is disclosed. The registrant is the filer, and the exhibit index shows only financial statements and press release. As a routine financial results filing, this does not meet the criteria for any special-situations category.
